active.detailsHtml:
Power BI customers may experience issues with Azure Maps where visuals will be shown as blank. Engineers have identified the issue and working on a mitigation. An update would be provided by 2:30 PM PST

 

Workaround: Affected users may clear their Microsoft Edge browser cache and retry loading the report. With Edge cache clearing, in Power BI Desktop, Azure Maps visuals may also be restored. If the issue persists, close and reopen Power BI Desktop after clearing the cache.
